tools.name: notifyre_list_sent_sms
tools.description: List SMS messages sent from the account, newest first by default, with recipient, status and cost. Without from_date the window is the last 30 days. Filter by status (processing, submitted, sent, failed), numbers, or a message id in search. Page with skip = next_skip. Notifyre API: GET /sms/send.

tools.name: notifyre_get_sent_sms
tools.description: Get one sent SMS message with every recipient: status, delivery status, message parts, cost. Use the id from notifyre_list_sent_sms or notifyre_send_sms. Notifyre API: GET /sms/send/{id}.

tools.name: notifyre_get_sms_recipient
tools.description: Get the text and delivery details of one recipient of a sent SMS (status, parts, cost). Notifyre API: GET /sms/send/{messageId}/recipients/{recipientId}.

tools.name: notifyre_list_sms_replies
tools.description: List SMS replies received on the account's numbers. Without from_date the window is the last 30 days. from_number and to_number must be given together. include_reply_content adds the reply texts (then at most 20 per page). Page with skip = next_skip. Notifyre API: GET /sms/received.

tools.name: notifyre_get_sms_reply
tools.description: Get one received SMS reply with its text, sender and receiving number. Use the replyID from notifyre_list_sms_replies. Notifyre API: GET /sms/received/{id}.

tools.name: notifyre_list_sms_numbers
tools.description: List the account's SMS numbers (E.164, status, 10DLC campaign) and approved alphanumeric sender IDs. Use one of them as `from` when sending. Notifyre API: GET /sms/numbers.

tools.name: notifyre_list_sms_prices
tools.description: List the price of one SMS per destination country (country code, calling prefix, price, currency). Check it before sending: the cost of a send is price x message parts x recipients. Notifyre API: GET /sms/send/prices.

tools.name: notifyre_list_sent_faxes
tools.description: List faxes sent from the account (recipient, pages, quality, status, failure reason). Without from_date the window is the last 30 days. Filter by status (accepted, successful, in_progress, failed, queued). Page with skip = next_skip. Notifyre API: GET /fax/send.

tools.name: notifyre_list_received_faxes
tools.description: List faxes received on the account's fax numbers (sender, number, time, pages, duration, read flag). The fax documents are not downloaded. Without from_date the window is the last 30 days. Page with skip = next_skip. Notifyre API: GET /fax/received.

tools.name: notifyre_list_fax_numbers
tools.description: List the account's fax numbers (E.164, region, status). Notifyre API: GET /fax/numbers.

tools.name: notifyre_list_fax_prices
tools.description: List the price of sending a fax per destination country (country code, calling prefix, price, currency). Notifyre API: GET /fax/send/prices.

tools.name: notifyre_list_fax_cover_pages
tools.description: List the fax cover page templates of the account (name and whether it is the default). The HTML of each template is left out. Notifyre API: GET /fax/coverpages.

tools.name: notifyre_list_contacts
tools.description: Search the address book. search_query matches the name; type FaxNumber or MobileNumber keeps contacts that have that number; group_ids limits to groups. Page numbers start at 0. Contacts that unsubscribed are left out unless include_unsubscribed is true. The unsubscribe key of a contact is never sho

tools.name: notifyre_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact: names, organization, email, fax and mobile number, groups, custom fields, unsubscribed flag. Notifyre API: GET /addressbook/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: notifyre_list_groups
tools.description: List the address book groups with their contact counts. Notifyre API: GET /addressbook/groups.

tools.name: notifyre_list_brands
tools.description: List the account's registered 10DLC brands (US SMS sender registration). Notifyre API: GET /numbers/brands.

tools.name: notifyre_list_campaigns
tools.description: List the account's 10DLC campaigns (US SMS use-case registrations) and their status. Notifyre API: GET /numbers/campaigns.

tools.name: notifyre_send_sms
tools.description: WRITE: SENDS REAL SMS to real people and SPENDS the prepaid balance of the user's Notifyre account; it cannot be undone or recalled and is never retried. One text to 1 to 10 mobile numbers in international format with "+" (e.g. +61412345678); no contacts, no groups, no scheduling. Cost = price per m

tools.name: notifyre_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: adds one contact to the Notifyre address book. Give at least a name or a number. Numbers in international format (e.g. +61412345678). groups takes existing group ids; group_name puts the contact in that group and CREATES the group if it does not exist. tools.name: notifyre_create_group
tools.description: WRITE: creates one address book group with the given name. Notifyre API: POST /addressbook/groups.

tools.name: notifyre_add_contacts_to_groups
tools.description: WRITE: adds existing contacts to existing groups (up to 100 contacts and 20 groups). Contacts keep their other groups. Adding a contact to a group does not send anything, but a later send to that group reaches it. Notifyre API: POST /addressbook/groups/contacts.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "notifyre_send_sms" is 1240 chars, far longer than this server's median (172). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: notifyre_list_sent_sms, notifyre_get_sent_sms, notifyre_list_sms_prices, notifyre_list_fax_cover_pages, notifyre_list_contacts, notifyre_get_contact, notifyre_send_sms · Private data: notifyre_list_received_faxes, notifyre_list_contacts, notifyre_get_contact, notifyre_list_groups, notifyre_send_sms, notifyre_create_contact, notifyre_add_contacts_to_groups · Public sink: notifyre_list_sent_sms, notifyre_get_sent_sms, notifyre_get_sms_recipient, notifyre_list_sms_replies, notifyre_get_sms_reply, notifyre_list_sms_numbers, notifyre_list_sms_prices, notifyre_list_sent_faxes, notifyre_list_fax_prices, notifyre_list_contacts, notifyre_get_contact, notifyre_list_brands, notifyre_list_campaigns, notifyre_send_sms, notifyre_create_contact, notifyre_create_group, notifyre_add_contacts_to_groups · Destructive: notifyre_send_sms, notifyre_create_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: notifyre_list_sent_sms, notifyre_get_sent_sms, notifyre_list_sms_prices, notifyre_list_fax_cover_pages, notifyre_list_contacts, notifyre_get_contact, notifyre_send_sms · Private data: notifyre_list_received_faxes, notifyre_list_contacts, notifyre_get_contact, notifyre_list_groups, notifyre_send_sms, notifyre_create_contact, notifyre_add_contacts_to_groups · Public sink: notifyre_list_sent_sms, notifyre_get_sent_sms, notifyre_get_sms_recipient, notifyre_list_sms_replies, notifyre_get_sms_reply, notifyre_list_sms_numbers, notifyre_list_sms_prices, notifyre_list_sent_faxes, notifyre_list_fax_prices, notifyre_list_contacts, notifyre_get_contact, notifyre_list_brands, notifyre_list_campaigns, notifyre_send_sms, notifyre_create_contact, notifyre_create_group, notifyre_add_contacts_to_groups · Destructive: notifyre_send_sms, notifyre_create_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
